searchText: Is there a chance that the devs will recommend a block size increase before the merge? Generally pools won't raise it until they get a signal that its safe to do so. I would fight against any such suggestions. I don't think I'm the only one either. Indeed it’s not a popular opinion 😛 That being said we got to past sizes based on Twitter posts from a dev 😂 why are blocktimes so random? Sometimes we see blocks in 15 seconds. Sometimes every 2 mins. And those 2 min blocks always double the gas and upset the whole network Blocktimes are effectively a Poisson distribution: https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poisson_distribution Even in the presence of stable hashrate, miners are searching for blocks / nonces that satisfy the difficulty condition. This is entirely random, so sometimes they find multiple solutions quickly... sometimes they find it just as quickly as they do on average. we just found 2 blocks at the same time yesterday and uncled ourselves 😄 <@!636289909359116290> that's funky! how does it happen? literally two subset of miners produce a valid block? I guess it's a net positive for the pool to include both the block and uncle because you end up with both rewards, right? indeed, usually its cause we find the same block on two different regions. Only seen it happen twice. Uncle was adopted into chain two blocks later. +1.5 ETH. https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/761212311049994267/912609136489938964/image0.png?width=391&height=847
